items.title: Introducing eve 1.0
items.summary: Today we're announcing , the open-source framework for building production-ready agents.eve 1.0Since the , we've worked with early adopters to prepare eve for 1.0, shipping 230+ releases and merging thousands of pull requests. With this release, eve is now generally available.public preview in JuneWe've made eve faster, expanded integrations, and improved observability. Security controls let you decide which actions need approval and what data gets collected. We've also made it easier for coding agents to build with, measuring that experience with a rigorous evaluation suite.With eve handling your harness and infrastructure, you and your agent can focus on building instead.The harness in eve is the loop that calls models, runs tools, and delegates work to subagents. You choose the model, add or replace tools, edit instructions, and decide which actions need approval. The open-source  saves progress as the agent runs, so it can pick up from its last completed step after a crash. Multiplayer sessions and agent-to-agent calls are built in.Workflow SDKFor managed hosting, deploy your eve agent to Vercel.  handles durable execution, and  runs agent-generated code in isolation.Vercel WorkflowsVercel SandboxBuild software factories that turn requests into tested pull requests, company brains that answer questions from your business data, or customer-facing agents in your product.Thousands of businesses already run eve in production for internal and customer-facing agents.  built a software factory on eve that takes in customer requests, converts them into specs, tests the changes, and opens PRs for human review. Rillet tripled its shipping rate in three months.  built monty, a data agent that answers employees’ questions in Slack. Just over two months in, 30–40% of the company used it every week.RilletClay's agent framework roundup names eve “Best for durable backend agents”.LindyMultiplayer lets several people work with an agent in one shared session. eve keeps track of who said what and directs approvals and sign-ins to the right person. You can set up memory for each user or the whole team.In the native , each thread is one shared session. Approvals appear as buttons that only the right person can answer, and a live task card shows progress and timing. You can follow up in the thread without mentioning the agent again, cancel the current turn, or reset the session from Slack.Slack channel lets an agent listen in channels you choose, even without being mentioned. Guided by goals you set per channel, it decides when to speak up, help, or take on a task, and when to stay quiet. To limit model costs, a small decision model screens every message first, and only the ones that might be for the agent start a turn.Ambient modeSlack is one of several native channels, alongside Microsoft Teams, Discord, Telegram, GitHub, Linear, Twilio, Web Chat, and iMessage. The  adds support for any Chat SDK platform adapter, including WhatsApp, Messenger, Google Chat, and email. Each channel is one file, and the same agent can work across all of them. See the  for the full list.Chat SDK channelintegrations directoryeve 1.0 expands our native integrations for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, TanStack Start, and Vite. The  build your agent alongside your app and set up its routes. On Vercel, you can deploy the agent and your site as one project, or host them separately.framework integrationsThe client libraries let you work with tool calls, approval requests, and questions in a consistent way across frameworks. Use that session data to build custom UIs: stream replies into agent chats, embed an agent in a page, or show the agent's tool calls in your own components.Use  to scaffold a chat app with  components, or add eve's React, Vue, or Svelte bindings to an existing UI.eve add channel/webAI ElementsOne support-agent deployment can connect to each customer's ticketing system with their own credentials and apply that customer's approval rules.Your application authenticates the user and identifies which tenant they belong to. You can then set , , and  for that tenant and user.memoryconnection credentialsapproval policyBefore each model call in the main agent loop,  load the agent's capabilities from the session and external data. In 1.0, they cover models, connections, and subagents as well as tools, skills, and instructions.dynamic definitionsWe added native  so agents can carry context from one session to the next.
